record_title: Exact compact-recurrence threshold and invariant-measure laws for the Rössler system
provenance: A parameter-uniform theorem for the classical positive-parameter Rössler flow, proved from exact invariant-measure balance laws, recurrence across the z=0 crossing plane, and compact-flow measure existence.
limitations: Assumes a,b,c>0 and does not classify dynamics above the discriminant threshold. At equality the conclusion for bounded trajectories is statistical rather than pointwise. Starkov--Starkov (2007) is a material residual prior-coverage risk because its full theorem statements were not accessible. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.
